proofs.population_scope: All replies, including government replies, publicly linked in section 2 of this archived ministry process page at retrieval; not all actual submissions and not national window completion.

window.basis: Submission/dispatch events remain separate from author dates and publication/hearing dates. Unknown dates retained.

claim_stage_and_source_closure.method: Targeted review for material factual, numerical and source-description errors, with primary draft/source checks for concrete leads. Policy choices and unsupported forecasts are not certified false or validated by a negative screen.
claim_stage_and_source_closure.issue_source_chain: For the sole GGV issue, exact operative text and explanatory note are archived and independently reviewed; other statements’ every footnote has not been independently validated.

cross_channel_checks.register_search: All 1,558 structured metadata records and all available extracted texts searched for exact ordinance names, ITKV/GGV and Wohnsitzanmeldung aliases. Two GGV records confirmed; no ITKV hit. One GGV acronym hit in Bürgerenergie concerned communal building energy and was excluded.
cross_channel_checks.register_limits: 86 records require OCR/visual review; keyword/metadata absence cannot prove no unnamed or image-only extra version.
cross_channel_checks.Bundestag_index: Root current Digital committee index closure: 28 listed pages across 3 fragments. Titles manually checked: no dedicated GGV/ITKV hearing. Underlying TKG hearing 4 November 2026 page currently links only bill, agenda and expert list, no response PDFs.
cross_channel_checks.Digital_publication_index: The 162 rows from the committee actual document publication API were checked by visible titles/aliases; no further explicit GGV/ITKV response was identified. Generic labels and unread bodies remain a gap.

limits: The denominator includes Länder replies and, for ITKV, an association reply explicitly declining a formal statement. Do not label all replies lobbyist submissions.
Consent-based publication, removed pages and later uploads can leave additional responses outside this bounded known-public set.
An older or undated author cover does not by itself settle a later transmittal date.
This proof closes link enumeration, archive integrity and author-text reading for a finite public page, not factual verification of every claim.
